items.source: Called when files have been changed.
changeSet - a set of the ChangedFiles

items.translation: 安迪·克莱门特，菲利普·韦伯

items.source: Callback interface when file changes are detected.
items.translation: 文件变更检测时的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
